sections.Profile:
"Bounty Hunter" is a pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in July 1985. It has a Western theme with three flippers and no ramps or multiball. Part of the Gottlieb System 80B series, the game was designed by John Buras with artwork by Larry Day. A total of 1,220 units were produced.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1985
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Western, Original Theme, Solid State, Guns, 1980s
